blocks.en: # Complex systems and research extensions **English** · [简体中文](RESEARCH.zh-CN.md) [Repository home](../README.md#contents) ## Sampling and benchmark design | Checkpoint | Evidence to record | Action if the check fails | | --- | --- | --- | | Minimization | Maximum force, energy trend, remaining local clashes | Inspect problematic atoms and parameters before dynamics | | NVT | Temperature around the setpoint, stable energy and restraint behavior | Check thermostat groups, time step, and starting velocities | | NPT | Time-windowed density and volume, temperature, mean pressure and variability | Review solvation, barostat, restraints and initial relaxation | | Production | Protein-aligned ligand RMSD and displacement, contacts, and block estimates with uncertainty | Examine jumps and state transitions, extend or increase replicas when uncertainty changes the inference | Run at least three independently initialized trajectories as a practical starting point for an exploratory comparison. State what you vary and analyze each replica before pooling. Remove a declared equilibration period, compare successive block averages, increase block length until the uncertainty estimate stabilizes, and verify coverage of the states needed for the research question. An RMSD plateau is one diagnostic. Density and pressure depend on the system, size, and ensemble. Set tolerances from the chosen protocol and the uncertainty needed for the observable.[R1](#research-ref-1) ## Complex systems before parameterization | System | Minimum checklist | | --- | --- | | Multichain or oligomer | Obtain the biological assembly and verify chain IDs and TER records; retain interface chains; define termini and check interchain covalent bonds deliberately | | Membrane | Select a biological orientation, membrane composition, and compatible lipid/ion parameters; use a membrane equilibration protocol and verify box dimensions and membrane properties | | Essential metal or cofactor | Preserve coordination geometry, cofactor connectivity and redox/protonation state; choose a validated model for that element, coordination, and force field | | Covalent ligand | Verify reaction product, atom charges, bond graph and residue naming; use an appropriate covalent-docking and parameterization method | | Missing or unusual residue | Review density/sequence context, alternative states, and breaks; validate modeled regions and add explicit force-field entries where needed | For a reviewed multichain protein, the following GROMACS 2026.3 example splits at changes of chain ID or TER and writes separate chain topologies. Use it only if these boundaries represent chemically separate chains. For an interchain disulfide or another covalent link, confirm the link and consider deliberate chain merging, then verify the actual bonds and molecule counts in the expanded topology.[R2](#research-ref-2)
blocks.zh: # 复杂体系与研究扩展 [English](RESEARCH.md) · **简体中文** [仓库首页](../README.zh-CN.md#contents) ## 采样与基准设计 | 检查点 | 记录的证据 | 失败后的操作 | | --- | --- | --- | | 能量最小化 | 最大力、能量趋势、局部冲突 | 动力学模拟前定位问题原子及参数 | | NVT | 目标温度附近的波动、能量及限制行为 | 检查温控组、时间步长和初始速度 | | NPT | 分窗统计密度和体积、温度、压力均值和波动 | 复核溶剂化、压控、限制和初始松弛 | | 生产模拟 | 蛋白叠合后的配体 RMSD、位移、接触及分块不确定度 | 检查跳变和状态转换；结论受不确定度影响时延长采样或增加重复 | 探索性比较可从至少三个独立初始化的轨迹开始。说明各重复改变了什么，先逐条分析，再考虑合并。剔除预先声明的平衡段，比较连续分块均值，增大分块长度直到不确定度估计稳定，并核对采样是否覆盖研究问题需要的状态。RMSD 平台只是一个诊断项。密度与压力的统计特性取决于体系、大小和系综，按方案及目标观测量精度定义容许范围。[R1](#research-ref-1) ## 复杂体系参数化前的最低核查 | 体系 | 最低核查 | | --- | --- | | 多链或多聚体 | 获取生物学组装，核对链 ID 与 TER；保留界面相关链；确定末端和链间共价连接 | | 膜体系 | 核对膜中朝向、膜组成及相容的脂质和离子参数；采用膜体系平衡方案，核验盒尺寸与膜性质 | | 必需金属或辅因子 | 保留配位几何、辅因子化学图与氧化/质子化状态；为对应元素、配位与 force field（力场）选择有验证的模型 | | 共价配体 | 确认反应产物、原子电荷、键图和残基命名；选用适配的共价对接和参数化方法 | | 缺失或非标准残基 | 复核密度/序列信息、替代状态和断裂；验证建模区域，按需补充明确的 force field（力场）条目 | 以下 GROMACS 2026.3 示例按链 ID 变化或 TER 分链，分别生成链的 topology（拓扑）。用于已确认这些位置确为独立化学链的组装。遇到链间二硫键或其他共价连接时，先确认连接，根据方案判断是否需要合并链，再核对展开 topology（拓扑）里的键和分子数量。[R2](#research-ref-2)

blocks.shared:
```bash
gmx pdb2gmx -f reviewed_assembly.pdb -o protein.gro -p protein.top -ff amber99sb-ildn -water tip3p -chainsep id_or_ter -merge no
```

blocks.en: Input is a curated assembly. Output is a GRO and chain topology files. Check termini, disulfides, residue logs and chain/molecule counts; stop at the first missing atom or unrecognized residue. Expected time and disk depend on assembly size. ## Parameterization and a paired AMBER–CHARMM comparison Choose the protein force field for the scientific protocol and use the corresponding ligand, water and ion parameter ecosystem. The public CPU smoke uses AMBER99SB-ILDN, GAFF2 and AM1-BCC. The reference CHARMM procedure uses CHARMM36m, CGenFF and the CHARMM-modified TIP3P and ion definitions from the selected cutoff port. Report the exact release of the parameter files and archive CGenFF atom mappings and parameter penalties. Per the CGenFF guidance, treat scores below 10 as a close analogy, 10–50 as a reason to validate the assigned parameter, and above 50 as a priority for detailed validation or reparameterization. Prioritize chemically important torsions and charges even at lower scores.[R3](#research-ref-3) Keep two independent directories. Match the source chemical graph, docked coordinates, temperature, salt target, time budgets and scientific observables. Use each force field's own parameter and switching scheme. Compare replicate distributions of ligand RMSD and contacts, density and uncertainty. The public example has a measured AMBER CPU smoke result. The matching CGenFF run requires a reviewed stream and its corresponding cutoff port. OpenFF Sage plus OpenFF Interchange can export a compatible small-molecule system to GROMACS. LigParGen is an option for a compatible OPLS-AA route. Check functional forms, combination rules, 1–4 scaling, charges, and topology/coordinate order before assembling components.[R4](#research-ref-4),[R5](#research-ref-5) ## Interaction analysis and figure evidence Use the matching complex frame from the verified trajectory as PLIP input. Preserve chain and residue identifiers. Review candidate assignments in [open-source PyMOL](https://github.com/schrodinger/pymol-open-source). Use ProLIF to assign frame-level interaction fingerprints and compute occupancy as observed frames divided by analyzed frames. State the window, stride, PBC treatment, protonation, interaction types and cutoffs. Report missing atoms and ambiguous ligand selection.[R6](#research-ref-6),[R7](#research-ref-7)
blocks.zh: 输入为已核查的组装。输出为 GRO 和各链 topology（拓扑）。核对末端、二硫键、残基日志及链与分子数量；遇到缺原子或无法识别的残基时先停止。耗时和磁盘占用取决于组装大小。 ## 参数化路线与 AMBER–CHARMM 配对比较 根据研究方案选定蛋白 force field（力场），以及同体系的配体、水和离子参数。公开 CPU 短测试用 AMBER99SB-ILDN、GAFF2 和 AM1-BCC。CHARMM 参考路线采用 CHARMM36m、CGenFF，以及所选普通截断移植包的 CHARMM-modified TIP3P 和离子参数。记录确切的参数版本并归档 CGenFF 原子映射与惩分。参考 CGenFF 指南，低于 10 表示相近类比，10–50 建议验证所分配参数，高于 50 优先详细验证或重新参数化。重要扭转和电荷即使惩分较低，也要优先核对。[R3](#research-ref-3) 分别建两个运行目录。匹配原始化学图、docking pose（对接位姿）坐标、温度、盐目标、模拟时长预算和所分析的观测量；各自采用其 force field（力场）配套参数和切换方式。比较各重复的配体 RMSD、接触、密度分布与不确定度。已实测的是公开 AMBER CPU 短测试。配对的 CGenFF 分支需先取得已核查的 stream 及相应普通截断移植包。 OpenFF Sage 和 OpenFF Interchange 可以将相容的小分子体系导出至 GROMACS。LigParGen 可用于相容的 OPLS-AA 路线。组装前核对函数形式、组合规则、1–4 缩放、电荷和 topology（拓扑）与坐标顺序。[R4](#research-ref-4),[R5](#research-ref-5) ## 接触分析与出图证据 用已核查轨迹中匹配的复合物帧作为 PLIP 输入，保留链与残基标识。在[开源 PyMOL](https://github.com/schrodinger/pymol-open-source)中核对候选相互作用。用 ProLIF 建逐帧相互作用指纹，以出现帧数除以分析帧数计算占有率。报告采样窗、步幅、PBC 处理、质子化状态、相互作用类型和阈值。注明缺原子和不确定的配体选择。[R6](#research-ref-6),[R7](#research-ref-7)

blocks.en: Run from the replicate directory with PLIP in a separate environment. Output is an XML report. PLIP 2.4.0 completed on the public 1IEP smoke frame. It annotated four hydrogen bonds, 11 hydrophobic contacts and one π-stacking interaction using its own typing and geometric rules. [Checked result](../examples/expected/plip-summary.csv) · [Adasme et al., PLIP 2021](https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkab294). One frame gives structure-level annotations; use the ProLIF trajectory workflow for occupancies. Time and disk scale with number of frames and interactions. For submission panels, retain the exported image and editable layout. Use the journal's specifications for final dimensions, resolution and fonts. Inkscape can assemble vector plots; GIMP or Krita can prepare raster panels. Follow [figure and agent guidance](ANALYSIS.md#agent-workflow). ## CHARMM endpoint setup and alchemical extensions Create a separate results directory and use the CHARMM soluble protein–small-molecule example from gmx_MMPBSA upstream as a compatibility check. Reimage and subsample a full-system XTC against the matching TPR, verify the receptor and ligand group IDs, and use the corresponding processed CHARMM topology. For GB, check supported radii and the GB model against the installed version. For PB, record ionic strength, radii, solvent/solute dielectrics and sampling stride. A 0.15 M bulk salt example is distinct from the final explicit ion count. Select groups and window from the actual run, then review the conversion log and per-frame outputs.[R8](#research-ref-8) For gmx_MMPBSA 1.7.0, save the following starting settings as `charmm_pbsa.in`. `PBRadii=7` assigns CHARMM-specific radii and `radiopt=0` uses those radii from the converted topology. The converter omits CHARMM CMAP terms. Assess that limitation before interpreting quantitative endpoint values.[R8](#research-ref-8)
blocks.zh: 在重复目录中用独立环境执行 PLIP。输出 XML 报告。PLIP 2.4.0 已在公开 1IEP 短测试的单帧完成分析。按该工具的原子分类与几何规则，得到 4 条氢键、11 个疏水接触与 1 个 π 堆积事件。[核验结果](../examples/expected/plip-summary.csv) · [Adasme et al., PLIP 2021](https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkab294)。单帧用于结构注释，占有率用 ProLIF 轨迹工作流计算。时间与磁盘占用随帧数和接触数量改变。投稿时保留导出的图与可编辑布局，成图尺寸、分辨率和字形遵循期刊要求。用 Inkscape 组装矢量图，用 GIMP 或 Krita 整理栅格图像。见[出图和 agent 说明](ANALYSIS.zh-CN.md#agent-workflow)。 ## CHARMM 端点法与炼金自由能扩展 单独建结果目录，用 gmx_MMPBSA 上游 CHARMM 可溶蛋白–小分子例先验证环境兼容性。用匹配 TPR 对全系统 XTC 做周期性边界修复和抽样，核对 receptor（受体）和配体的组编号，使用相应的展开 CHARMM topology（拓扑）。GB 分支按安装版本核对允许的半径及 GB 模型。PB 分支记录离子强度、半径、溶剂与溶质介电常数及抽样间隔。示例 0.15 M 表示体相盐浓度，显式体系的离子总数另计。从实际运行选组和时间窗，再核查转换日志和逐帧输出。[R8](#research-ref-8) 对 gmx_MMPBSA 1.7.0，可将以下起始设置保存为 `charmm_pbsa.in`。`PBRadii=7` 分配 CHARMM 专用半径，`radiopt=0` 让 PBSA 使用转换后的 topology（拓扑）中保存的半径。转换程序省略 CHARMM CMAP 项，解释定量端点能量前须评估这一限制。[R8](#research-ref-8)

blocks.shared:
```ini
&general
  startframe=1,
  endframe=4,
  PBRadii=7,
/
&pb
  radiopt=0,
  istrng=0.150,
  fillratio=4.0,
/
```

```bash
gmx_MMPBSA -nogui -i charmm_pbsa.in -cs md.tpr -ct charmm_window.xtc -ci index.ndx -cg "$protein_group" "$ligand_group" -cp md_processed.top -o CHARMM_PBSA.dat -eo CHARMM_PBSA.csv
```

blocks.en: Set both shell group variables for the reviewed index before running. Input syntax and environment installation are in [the endpoint walkthrough](ANALYSIS.md#endpoint-energy). The four-frame input is an example of software compatibility testing. The upstream fixture uses groups `Protein` and `JZ4`, `com.tpr`, `com_traj.xtc`, and `topol.top` with its accompanying `toppar/` includes. Confirm that the summary and per-frame CSV correspond to the intended groups and frame count before expanding the analysis. These settings were checked against the upstream example. This repository has no independent CHARMM endpoint result.[R8](#research-ref-8) Use relative alchemical binding free energies for a well-defined set of congeneric, consistently parameterized ligands with agreed atom mappings. Absolute binding free energies require a separate restraint and standard-state protocol. Both require state overlap and convergence diagnostics. AI docking models can supply additional candidate poses for independent redocking, chemical and geometric checks.[R9](#research-ref-9) ## References and official documentation - [Grossfield et al. Best Practices for Quantification of Uncertainty and Sampling Quality in Molecular Simulations](https://doi.org/10.33011/livecoms.1.1.5067) - [GROMACS 2026.3 pdb2gmx](https://manual.gromacs.org/2026.3/onlinehelp/gmx-pdb2gmx.html) - [MacKerell Lab CHARMM parameter sets and GROMACS ports](https://mackerell.umaryland.edu/charmm_ff.shtml) · [CGenFF tutorial](https://docs.silcsbio.com/2026/cgenff/usage.html) - [OpenFF Interchange](https://github.com/openforcefield/openff-interchange) - [LigParGen](https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkx312) - [Salentin et al. PLIP: fully automated protein–ligand interaction profiler](https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkv315) · [PLIP GitHub](https://github.com/pharmai/plip) - [Bouysset and Fiorucci. ProLIF: a library to encode molecular interactions as fingerprints](https://doi.org/10.1186/s13321-021-00548-6) · [ProLIF Documentation](https://prolif.readthedocs.io/) - [gmx_MMPBSA 1.7.0 CHARMM protein–ligand example](https://valdes-tresanco-ms.github.io/gmx_MMPBSA/1.7.0/examples/Protein_ligand_CHARMMff/) - [Mey et al. Best Practices for Alchemical Free Energy Calculations](https://doi.org/10.33011/livecoms.2.1.18378)
blocks.zh: 运行前按已核对的索引设置两个组编号变量。[端点法教程](ANALYSIS.zh-CN.md#endpoint-energy)给出输入格式和环境方法。四帧设置用于说明软件兼容性核验。上游示例使用 `Protein` 与 `JZ4` 两组、`com.tpr`、`com_traj.xtc` 和带有 `toppar/` 配套文件的 `topol.top`。扩大分析窗前，先核对摘要与逐帧 CSV 对应的组和帧数。这里的设置已对照上游示例。本仓库尚无独立的 CHARMM 端点法实测结果。[R8](#research-ref-8) 相对炼金结合自由能适合定义明确、参数化一致并已确定原子映射的同系列配体。绝对结合自由能需要单独的约束和标准态方案。两种方案均需诊断状态重叠与收敛。AI 对接模型可用于补充候选 docking pose（对接位姿），并通过独立重对接和化学、几何核查验证。[R9](#research-ref-9) ## 参考文献与官方文档 - [Grossfield et al.
